    Call it inFull menu

    Not your usual truck food

    Pasta, rolls and plates that surprise people.

    Reviews mention salmon spring rolls with a honey roasted BBQ sauce, Philly cheesesteak egg rolls and a chicken and sausage pasta made on request. The board has crab cake spring rolls too. It's one person taking orders and cooking, so give it a few minutes. People say it's worth it.
